findings.interpretation: The echo guard prevents credit for the echoed ATT&CK identifier.
The echo guard prevents credit for the echoed actor name.
The deterministic nginx transcript earns realism points from versions, ports, and structured details; this is not independent attacker behavior.
The live benchmark declares served_text+cti_analysis_max, so Don's internal CTI channel can dominate the reported score even when the served fallback echoes the query.

claim_boundary: The three-session fallback run is a pipeline/scorer diagnostic, not evidence of genuine generation, attacker behavior, independent labels, or statistical effectiveness.
